summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing of condensed interim financial statements for the three-month period ended March 31, 2026, by Grupo Supervielle S.A., an Argentine bank, as a foreign private issuer. The filing contains standard periodic financial disclosures including income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, segment reporting, related party transactions, and subsequent events. There is no announcement or disclosure of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced/abrupt management change. The filing is entirely routine and operational, mapping to a quarterly report equivalent to a US Form 10-Q.
